definitions.explanation: The first day of an event, performance run, tournament, or period. Often refers to the opening day of a show or competition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{初日|しょにち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧だった。
examples.english: The opening day of the performance was sold out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧{初日|しょにち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{好|こう}⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: We got off to a good start from the first day of the tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{初日|しょにち}⟦{興行|こうぎょう}→興行：13985_kougyou⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歴代|れきだい}→歴代：13199_rekidai⟧⟦{一|いち}{位|い}→一位：08926_ichii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The film's opening day box office revenue set an all-time record.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first) + ⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧ (day). Commonly used for performances, tournaments, sales events, and similar multi-day occasions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初日|しょにち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to welcome opening day)
- ⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧{初日|しょにち} (opening night of a show)
- ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧{初日|しょにち} (first day of a tournament)
- {初日|しょにち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the very first day)
- {初日|しょにち}の{出|で} (the first sunrise of the new year — read as はつひので)

USAGE:
Note the different reading {初日|はつひ}の{出|で} (はつひので) specifically for the first sunrise of the new year, which is a traditional New Year's custom. In all other contexts, the reading is しょにち.
